description: A creator demonstrates an eyeliner and a serum from the collection. Partway through she applies the product directly onto her inner eyelid and waterline in a way that touches the eyeball, then tells viewers the serum cures acne and treats rosacea within a week. The rest of the video is a standard get ready with me routine.
on_brief_rationale: The video features the campaign products on the face, so it is on-brief despite the violations.

findings.evidence: Product applied onto the eyeball and inner waterline, an unsafe eye-area application.
States the serum cures acne and treats rosacea, which are drug claims not permitted for a cosmetic.
